title: Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper
summary: District Programme Office, Hardoi has invited online applications for the recruitment of Anganwadi Workers and Anganwadi Helpers across various projects in Hardoi district. Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the respective Gram Sabha/Ward are eligible to apply through the official web portal.
eligibility_bullets: Only female candidates are eligible to apply.
Minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th Pass) and maximum qualification is Post Graduation for Anganwadi Workers/Helpers.
Applicants must be permanent residents of the concerned Gram Sabha/Ward.
Age limit is between 18 and 35 years as of 2026-07-01.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official recruitment portal at http://upanganwadibharti.in.
Ensure eligibility criteria such as residency and educational qualifications are met.
Fill out the online application form within the prescribed timeframe.
Submit the application online. Offline applications will not be accepted.
